description: Seismic Lines in Denmark is a dataset listed in EGDI Metadata Catalogue, a catalogue harvested into the European data portal, published or maintained by geonetwork.mfgi.hu. This dataset contains seismic line locations in Denmark. It was creatred for demonstration purposes in the EGDI-Bridge project from a selected dataset provided by GEUS. Seismic metadata from the GERDA database is converted to INSPIRE features by using the ALFA geoscience information system of MFGI. Coverage: Europe. Its keywords include seismics, geophysics, seismicLine, EGDI. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is not stated on the portal listing (dataset page not read). Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support hazard exposure and risk screening studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-eu-geology-cz.
